text:
Alex: Quick heads-up: planning to canary deploy scoped RBAC + route-quota evaluator tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need preflight/rollback checklist. Any missing failure modes?

Maria: +1. Off the top: accidental global grants, quota misassignment, broken preview panel, and mismatched audit entries.

Kevin: Past hits: role template matching too-broad, routing-priority change routed traffic to cold GPU pools, and cache invalidation causing token errors.

Liz: Security reqs: MFA + approver for role-template pushes, signed rollout requests, immutable audit record per change, and emergency read-only console fallback if audit store unreachable.

Samira: UX: preview needs to show "effective permissions" per-tenant & per-route (explicit list). Block rollout if preview fails. Add inline help for scope expressions.

Kevin: Ops plan: runtime feature flag for new scope-eval. Default off. Canary -> 5% tenants by tenant_id hash; telemetry for permission_denied_rate, route_affinity shifts, quota_overrun events.

Alex: Can SRE get a tiny API to toggle rollouts from Console? Keep it atomic and auditable.

Kevin: Proposed API:
```
POST /internal/rollouts
{
  "feature":"scoped_rbac_v2",
  "state":"on|off|partial",
  "percent":"0-100",
  "tenants": ["t-123"],
  "ticket":"INC-1234"
}
```
Resp: 200 + rollout_id

Liz: Add caller identity header, signature, and allowlist for callers. Persist ticket id and approver id.

Matt: Alerts: permission_denied_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> auto-fallback and create incident with rollout_id. Also watch for console_preview_error_rate and audit_ingest_lag.

Samira: For Console: show rollout status (percent, tenants sample), revert button (runs state=off and logs reason), and disabled state explanation if preview blocked.

Maria: Migration safety: only additive schema changes. Dual-eval mode for two deploy cycles, and a migration flag to flip canonical evaluator after canary passes.

Kevin: Also capture both evaluators' decisions for each request for 7 days for forensics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started rollout_id=r-20260320-9 at 2432121000

Alex: Owners: Kevin -> API/flagging + tests, Samira -> preview UX & blocking states, Liz -> gating & audit, Matt -> alerts & auto-fallback. Sync 08:30 PT tomorrow.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll write the preflight doc and ping eng-platform when it's ready.

Kevin: Will open PR tonight with schema + unit tests.

Samira: I'll attach mock screenshots and a short gif of the preview.

Alex: Great. If anyone thinks of additional edge-cases (cross-tenant role copy, service-account token propagation), add here.
